releases.displayName: BIG UPDATE HAS ARRIVED! 🔥 PLAY FIGHT SCHOOL SIMULATOR NOW! 🥋

items.text: Sensei, this one is big. We went through the whole game: a new story arc, a Hall of Champions for your medals, a city that lives through day and night, smarter students, punchier combat, a fully reworked interface and a serious performance pass.

[p align="start"]Your uncle's story isn't over. After his defeat, his son swears revenge. A warning banner with his portrait keeps reminding you that he's coming, and a few in-game days later he shows up in the city square with his whole gang behind him, now in their own crimson-and-silver uniforms so you can tell them apart from your uncle's men at a glance.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/e69a73db2f5f7ed190d55ddf3cbba5aa936d057e.png"]
This time he isn't fighting with his fists. The cousin carries a katana with a full set of sword animations, and when you finally bring him down he falls with a proper death animation.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/36bad39dc531079cf993ac1b8ddf1a403b546575.jpg"]He brought friends, in their own colors.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/a2e5c6a7b28481cdfe5ac8dd074c071546842e7b.gif"]

[p align="start"]Every tournament you win now leaves its mark. A new Hall of Champions board hangs behind your manager desk with a slot for every international championship: USA, Türkiye, Japan, China, Brazil and more. Win a country's tournament and its gold, silver or bronze medal drops onto the board for everyone who walks into your school to see.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/c2b3d2712fd1a927453a12b8d2e17a5a2f8021e6.jpg"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/7bf97bc19cbb62ca57f2041cb68f9f10fa14ef1d.gif"]
A new medal drops in and settles on its hook.

[p align="start"]Many of you told us the board was hard to fill, and you were right. A tournament is decided round by round, and your student has to win every round in a row, so even a strong fighter rarely made it through an eight-round championship.
Every round now gives your student +15% win chance (capped at 95%).
Tournament invitations now arrive at least once a day while you have a qualified student.
8-round championship 2% → 12%
4-round championship 13% → 35%

notes.title: A City That Lives Through Day and Night

items.text: [p align="start"]The day/night cycle was rebuilt from the ground up. Instead of switching between two looks, the city now blends continuously: the sun, ambient light, fog and sky shift through the afternoon, the street lamps fade in at dusk, and the night has its own color grade.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/1d9162acb66481b06f98a804614e2b894224bbab.gif"]
Noon to midnight in five seconds.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/c5df21c02542991f29425ae7f01fc4a41e5cd45e.jpg"]

[p align="start"]We reworked the post-processing volumes for every part of the game: the gameplay day, the DLC day, the night and the dream. Colors are richer, highlights glow, and every area has its own mood.
[p align="start"]The dream got a brand-new grade: moonlit violets, glowing lanterns and lavender fields around the sacred tree.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/f5817e7b2849ffb97a1983aff4da47d277b6a2a3.jpg"]

[p align="start"]Every strike now has weight. New impact effects (flash, sparks, shock ring and dust) burst on each hit and take the attacker's color: gold for your school, your rival school's color for them, red-orange for everyone else. Heavy hits get a bigger burst, and the effects stay semi-transparent so even big brawls remain easy to read.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/2f846df0ed6c8f8e7360473a613a25a1ad15d565.gif"]
Gold impacts mark your school's hits.
Booster flashes: drinking a booster gives a quick full-screen flash in its own color: gold for stamina, red for health, cyan for speed, orange for hit power and violet for damage reduction.
Fight mode vignette: entering fight mode frames the screen with a clean, steady vignette so you always know you're in combat.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/c79e1df7e5819fc27f5617e9c55b4c3217120e02.gif"]

[p align="start"]Your combination grew from 3 to 5 strike slots, plus the special flying kick slot, so you can chain longer, more varied combos. The Technique Ledger was redesigned to match. The demonstration video sits top-left and plays the first move automatically, your learned techniques fill a three-column card grid beside it, and your combined moves run along the bottom as six labeled slots. The flying kick slot stays locked until you learn it.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/8aca389d7fb7911ddec0b51074c90a91922537a5.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/2b42ac1a3e16a16c0b01d3e7c032470b859fff6e.jpg"]
[p align="start"]The Student List was redesigned to show each student's techniques at a glance, with progress and kick/punch focus. Open a quick version anytime with L.

[p align="start"]New: a Follow me button right on the student's detail page. If the student is out in the city, one click and they come to you, exactly like the F1 command. It only shows when the student can actually follow you and your follower group still has room.
[table equalcells="1" colwidth="344,"][td colwidth="344"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/56918df2e6ec44a124e060857bcead55259561ca.jpg"]From the manager's record book.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/887ad87fbf0b39b35406234f65bc1819ccf6d78b.jpg"]From the quick list (L).
You can now have 8 grasshoppers from the start (previously 5 until you opened your second school).
Grasshoppers walk to the exact work point before cleaning or repairing and play their animations smoothly, with no more floating or sliding.
Sweeping kicks up a denser cloud of dust a little ahead of the broom, so cleaning finally feels like cleaning.
The training equipment's collider no longer blocks the dirt under it when you clean.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/dc4d1364375feb2a72e9e4b7517cbdf6d8c12470.gif"]
Smarter Students
Students spend far less time standing idle: they pick their next task within a few seconds.
Students no longer jam into each other in corners. They keep a natural distance, one of them yields when two meet head-on, and a student who can't reach a crowded spot settles nearby and moves on.
No more sliding when a student “realizes” something mid-walk, and equipment animations stop when a student leaves the machine.
During the “choose your first grasshopper” quest, the grasshopper button now also appears in the L student panel.
Remade Posters
[p align="start"]Every motivational poster for your hall was remade with a cohesive ink-painting style, clearer lettering and fixed typos. Hang them up and your students will feel it.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/017317cf01a998c3b93a013bf11aaa72c4335ae1.jpg"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/d8e461f61ca4316ae794ce1322cf8756c6b6ba1f.jpg"]The upper floor, posters up.
Every screen redesigned, one by one, across the base game and the DLC.
Window animations: panels open with a soft fade and scale, buttons respond to hover and clicks, and scenes fade in smoothly.
Ready for China: the student record book on your desk now holds real Chinese calligraphy describing your school's rules, alongside the full Chinese localization.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/3b31faf6d0c135ce8c875c249d0a28c136e88984.jpg"]武馆弟子名册 — the school's register of disciples.
[p align="start"]We profiled the game in its busiest moments, with a full school of 50+ students on screen, and fixed what actually cost frames.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/516590c0a07c4405bc01fb0bda3eb1e98b77dbf6.jpg"]
Up to 240 fewer draw calls per frame: tiny face details (eyes, teeth, tongue) no longer cast shadows, and mouth details stop rendering when they're too far away to see.
About 0.5 ms less CPU per frame on the main and render threads in crowded scenes.
4-bone skinning on Ultra: characters look the same and cost less GPU time.
No more save hitches: saving is batched in the background instead of happening on every hit and every rep.
Lighter per-frame work in the clock UI and student AI.
Tournament invitations stopped arriving in some saves. Fixed.
The school-sign designer no longer opens the record book behind it.
The grasshopper button is now available during the grasshopper quest.
Students no longer slide or float on equipment.
Plus many smaller fixes across the base game and the DLC.
Thank you for training with us. Your feedback shaped almost every change in this update, so keep it coming in the discussions and reviews. Now go fill that Hall of Champions! 🥋🥊🥷🥋
Ahhh Important Note: This is a big update. I tested a lot but I might also break something and cause bugs. Please, if you face any bugs, let me know. I will be grateful!
Kind Regards,
Queen Developer

releases.displayName: GET READY, SENSEIS! 🥋MASSIVE UPDATE ARRIVES OCTOBER 30🔥

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/d6353f91e30504b62eed546ce59305eea79620a4.jpg"]

Senseis! 🥋🥋🥋 I’ve spent the last few weeks going through every corner of Fight School Simulator, and I honestly can’t wait for you to play this one. A lot of it came straight from your reviews and messages. 🤜 You told me what felt hard, what felt flat and what you wanted more of, and I listened. Here’s what’s coming:
The Cousin’s Revenge: your uncle’s son swears vengeance and arrives with a katana and a crimson-clad gang.
Hall of Champions: a medal board behind your desk that fills with gold, silver and bronze from every country you conquer.
Winnable tournaments: +15% win chance every round, and invitations at least once a day.
A living city: a smooth day/night cycle with street lamps at dusk, new post-processing everywhere, and a moonlit dream sequence.
Punchier combat: impact effects in your school’s colors, booster flashes and a fight-mode vignette.
5 strike slots instead of 3, plus the flying kick, in a fully redesigned Technique Ledger.
Follow me: call any student to your side straight from the Student List.
8 grasshoppers from day one, and a cleaner school with real sweeping dust.
Smarter students who stop jamming into each other and idle far less.
Remade ink-style posters, a redesigned interface with smooth animations, and Chinese calligraphy in your record book.
A big performance pass: up to 240 fewer draw calls and no more save hitches.
Get ready. Polish your belts, warm up your students and clear a wall for those medals. On October 30 your school gets bigger, stronger and more alive than ever. See you on the mat! 🥷🥷🥷

items.text: Greatingd Dear Masters 🥋
A new update for Fight School Simulator PC is now live! 🔥

Before sharing the update notes, I want to sincerely thank everyone who has supported the game, played it, shared feedback, reported issues, and helped me improve Fight School Simulator step by step. Your comments and suggestions really help me make the game better.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/4291cc64b7476404e5b8aedb979154fbae8d336f.jpg"]
Some localization issues have been fixed and improved.
Achievement triggers have been checked, and several adjustments have been made.
The opening video sound is now connected to the audio settings. Dream sequences, the cinematic trailer, and in-game sounds now all follow the player’s audio settings properly.
The camera follow/shake effect has been softened during the newly learned combo double-hit move. This should make the move feel smoother and prevent dizziness.

A congratulation message has been added after all rival schools are defeated. Of course, players can still keep playing, grow their dojo, recruit more students, and continue their journey to claim a spot on the Global Top Masters List!
Due to many player requests, the Meditation mini-game sound has been reduced, collider issues have been adjusted, and players can now leave meditation without completing all meditation tasks.
Minor bug fixes and adjustments have been made.
I am still working on new improvements and trying to make the game better with every update.
Stay tuned and always fight with Honor! 🥋🤗

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/9aec3fff77ce05e1bd279c6971b48439d20aec1e.jpg"]
Hey all Fight School Masters!
Big salute to everyone grinding in the dojo! 👊 I’ve just pushed a new update for Fight School Simulator, and I wanted to share what’s new with you:
🎮 Partial Gamepad Support is here!
You can now play the game using a gamepad. Movement, fighting, menus — they all work with a controller now.
Small heads-up: gamepad button icons are not visible in the UI yet, but everything is fully functional. UI prompts for controllers are coming in the next updates, so this is just the first step.
🛠️ Engine Upgrade – Unity 6.3
I’ve upgraded the project to the latest Unity 6.3 and taken a fresh build. This should help with stability and future improvements.
🐞 Minor Bug Fixes
I also squashed a few small bugs along the way. Nothing flashy, but the game should feel a bit smoother now.
As always, your feedback, bug reports, and crazy ideas mean a lot to me. I’m building this game solo, so every message you send actually shapes the future of Fight School Simulator.
Now back to training 🥋 your students are waiting! 💪🔥

notes.title: What’s New & Improved on Main Game

items.text: 👨‍🎓 Student Collisions Fixed — Students no longer push or trap you! You can now move around freely and train in peace.

🖥️ Management Desk Improvements — You can now exit the management desk using not just "E" but also F or ESC for more intuitive controls.
🔥 New DLC – Reclaim the Honor

The city’s martial arts schools were attacked and extorted. Your school was destroyed. The Master returns to train a new generation and fight back. It’s time to rebuild your dojo, learn new styles, and face the mafia.

items.text: Dear Fight School Masters! 🥋 Attention please. I am happy to say that I have reviewed your feedback, watched some of your gameplay videos and released a quick update.

notes.title: You can find the update details listed below

items.text: Rival Students' AI
The AI logic of Rival Students and Enemies are improved. I am still working on this and making better and better day by day.
Player Interaction Logic

Player interaction logic is changed. Now, we don't need to use R key for repair and F key for Follow. All we need to use (Interaction, Cleaning, Repearing, Building, Commanding our Students, etc.) is "E" and Mouse Leff Button.
Message Notification on UI
I have added a notification UI element on Scene. It is located on Top and Right and comes with an animation. So, you will be aware of you have a new message waiting on your Management desk.
3 New Info Panel for Better Understanding of Game Mechanics.

I have added three new info panel about Why we need to do marketing? Who is Grasshopper? and What is the purpose of hanging Posters on our Walls? I think our players will have better understanding now.
